scope: Synthetic media and metadata, actual Go services, local filesystems and independent SDK processes; no production/NAS changes

storage_move.proof: original SourceSnapshot and SHA, instance/key, sealed operation result, verified stage, exclusive target publication
storage_move.cold_recovery: new SDK process, no second move or completion callback, recreated source retained

directory_transfer_move.proof: original directory snapshot, per-member snapshots/SHA, explicit source/target mapping and actual target files
directory_transfer_move.history: single original root; source empty containers retained
directory_transfer_move.cold_recovery: original source not reread; replacement source members retained

copy_attributes.destination_policy: ordinary 0666 creation subject to umask and inherited ACL; no source chmod/copystat
copy_attributes.atime_note: set from source before-read stat; subsequent verification reads may update it

history_absence: completed exact directory move reconciles missing source after old roots removed; recreated directory is not granted deletion
